metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve a stomach ache (and abdominal pain) with easy exercises.

These exercises will help stimulate the digestive system and help relieve trapped gas, bloating, and constipation -- main causes of a stomach ache.

Each exercise works differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives the most relief.

Watch now and get instant stomach ache and abdominal pain relief!

0:00 Intro
0:33 Stomach Massage
2:11 Abdominal Squeezing
4:15 Twist and March
5:54 Gas Relieving Stretch
